what_it_does: Large-scale computational workflows generate massive amounts of provenance data (metadata tracking which computations ran, in what order, with what inputs). Analyzing this data is hard using traditional tools like custom scripts or SQL queries. This paper proposes letting users ask natural language questions to AI agents, which convert questions into structured database queries and retrieve answers using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG—searching relevant documents before answering). The approach is evaluated across multiple AI models including LLaMA, GPT, Gemini, and Claude.
